title: An optimism bonus shrinks
hook: Two stated cases: explore the pull count in a specified UCB rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the pull count in a specified UCB rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines UCB, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the pull count in a specified UCB rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
